name: hydra-strk
description: Private messaging on Starknet: what leaks is computed from the code that makes it true, never asserted

//directory: The package lives in a subdirectory, and npmjs.com resolves the README's relative links
against repository.url + this. Without it every `packages/...` link on the package page
resolves a level too high and 404s; the README renders correctly on GitHub either way, so
the breakage is invisible from inside the repo. Links that point ABOVE this directory
cannot be fixed here and are absolute in the README instead.

//bin: THREE, matching what a checkout links. `hydra-vault` was missing here while
`dist/vault-server/src/main.js` shipped in the tarball with a shebang and a working server
behind it — so an operator who installed the package got the code and no way to run it,
and the README promised the command anyway. `packages/vault-server/package.json` declares
the same bin for the workspace, which is why a checkout had it and the published package
There is no `hydra-gui`. The loopback API is `hydra gui`, a subcommand — `packages/gui/src/
main.ts` names itself that in its own header and its banner prints it.

scripts.test: npm run typecheck && npm run check:citations && node --test packages/identity/test/*.test.ts $(ls packages/adversary/test/*.test.ts | grep -v '/live-')
scripts.prepack: rm -rf dist && npm run build && cp ../LICENSE .
